name: Data annotators and AI trainers
oneLiner: The most accessible on-ramp into AI work, and the one that rewards domain expertise over coding.
why: Labeled data and preference feedback are inputs the models cannot generate for themselves
Domain knowledge (medicine, law, finance) is the scarce input, not programming
threats: Individual-contributor annotation is hourly, insecure and often outsourced
Automated labelling compresses the bottom of the market over time

claims.text: Data annotator ranks fourth among LinkedIn's fastest-growing US job titles for 2026.
The work is reviewing and labelling data to specified guidelines and running quality checks so that training datasets are accurate.
